zh.title: 歐盟撥款 2,950 萬歐元予立陶宛、愛沙尼亞生產無人機彈頭
zh.summary: 歐盟透過EDIP撥款2,950萬歐元予立陶宛與愛沙尼亞研製遊蕩彈藥彈頭
body: 歐盟透過歐洲國防工業計畫（EDIP）於2026年10月14日宣佈，向立陶宛國防公司RSI Europe與愛沙尼亞公司Odin Defence撥款2,950萬歐元（約3,310萬美元），支援名為RagnaRasa的聯生專案，製造遊蕩彈藥用彈頭與炸藥。
根據委員會成果概覽，RagnaRasa獲得第三大撥款，略低於單一專案3,000萬歐元上限；八個入選專案預計自2027年起每年產出超過20萬枚此類彈頭。
專案將愛沙尼亞的炸藥與零組件製造，與立陶宛的最終組裝、測試及認證相結合，RSI Europe執行長Tomas Milašauskas表示這是建立區域防禦產能的關鍵步驟。
Odin Defence將在愛沙尼亞帕爾努郡的Ermistu國防產業園區建立生產設施，愛沙尼亞國防投資中心（ECDI）已於2026年3月與其簽署協議，確認其為英國Thor Industries Ltd子公司，專注於塑膠炸藥。
Ermistu園區預計2027年投產，愛沙尼亞另投入逾5,000萬歐元建設基礎設施，園區亦將容納Frankenburg Technologies營運的短程防空飛彈生產線。

en.title: EU awards €29.5M to Lithuania and Estonia for loitering munition warhead production
en.summary: EU funds €29.5M for Lithuania‑Estonia loitering munition warhead project
body: The European Commission announced on 14 October 2026 that Lithuanian defence firm RSI Europe and Estonia‑based Odin Defence secured €29.5 million (US$33.1 million) in EU funding for the joint RagnaRasa project to manufacture warheads and explosives for loitering munitions.

According to the Commission’s results factsheet, RagnaRasa received the third‑largest award, just below the €30 million per‑project ceiling; across the eight selected projects the Commission expects annual output of more than 200,000 such warheads from 2027.

The project links explosives and component manufacturing in Estonia with final assembly, testing and qualification in Lithuania, and RSI Europe CEO Tomas Milašauskas called it the next step in building industrial capacity and regional defence capability.

Odin Defence will establish its production facility at Estonia’s Ermistu defence industrial park in Pärnu County. The Estonian Center for Defence Investments (ECDI) signed an agreement with Odin Defence in March 2026, identifying it as a subsidiary of UK‑based Thor Industries Ltd specialising in plastic explosives.

Production at Ermistu is expected to begin in 2027. Estonia is investing more than €50 million (US$56.1 million) in infrastructure for the park, which will also host a short‑range air‑defence missile production facility operated by Frankenburg Technologies.

zh.title: 勞斯萊斯擬獲英政府補貼推UltraFan 30
zh.summary: 勞斯萊斯擬獲英補貼；金額£1‑2億；下週或宣佈UltraFan 30
body: 勞斯萊斯據報正接近與英國政府達成一項龐大補貼協議，以推進其新型窄體引擎UltraFan 30的開發。
據《金融時報》報導，政府資助金額可能在1億至2億英鎊（約1.33億至2.67億美元）之間，最快下週對外宣佈。
勞斯萊斯首席執行官圖凡·埃爾金比利奇於2026年7月確認，與政府的磋商已取得進展。
公司於2011年退出國際航空發動機聯盟，結束為空中巴士A320系列提供V2500引擎的合作。

en.title: Rolls‑Royce nears UK subsidy deal to advance UltraFan 30 narrowbody engine
en.summary: Rolls‑Royce close to UK subsidy of £100‑200 m for UltraFan 30; announcement possible next week
body: Rolls‑Royce is reportedly close to securing a large UK government subsidy to advance development of its new narrowbody engine, the UltraFan 30.
The Financial Times says the aid could range from £100 million to £200 million (about $133 million‑$267 million), with an announcement possible as early as next week.
Chief Executive Tufan Erginbilgic confirmed in July 2026 that talks with the government on engine support were progressing.
Rolls‑Royce left the narrowbody market in 2011 when it exited the International Aero Engines consortium that supplied the V2500 engine for the Airbus A320 family.
